title: Everyday Phrases — Buying Skincare Products
scene_zh: 買護膚品 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi, can you help me find skincare?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🧴 實用買護膚品必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Buying Skincare Products
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用買護膚品情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從說明的膚質、試用品與過敏測試，到比價、結帳與護膚叮嚀，一次學會。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Buying Skincare Products phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering skin types, testers, prices, checkout and care tips. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, can you help me find skincare?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ kæn ju hɛlp mi faɪnd ˈskɛrˌkeɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，能幫我找找護膚品嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what does your skin feel like?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wət dʌz jʊr skɪn fil laɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你的皮膚感覺怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels tight after I wash it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz taɪt ˈæftər aɪ wɑʃ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 洗完臉以後覺得很緊繃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds like dry skin, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，那聽起來像乾性皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But my nose gets oily fast.
dialogue.zh: 可是我的鼻子很快就出油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry cheeks, oily nose and forehead.
dialogue.zh: 兩頰幹，鼻子和額頭出油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see that mix a lot here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðæt mɪks ə lɑt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我在這兒常見這種膚質。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell a face wash for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ə feɪs wɑʃ fər ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有適合這種膚質的洗面奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, it is right this way.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ɪt ɪz raɪt ðɪs weɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我需要溫和一點的產品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This gel cleanser is very gentle.
dialogue.zh: 這款凝膠潔面乳非常溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it foam up a lot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a little, so it feels soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ˈlɪtəl soʊ ɪt filz sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 只有一點，所以感覺很柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 很好，我討厭很重的泡沫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy foam can dry you out.
dialogue.zh: 厚重的泡沫會讓你皮膚變幹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else should I look at?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 洗完臉之後要用化妝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A toner? I heard that word.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它在乳液之前讓皮膚清爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的皮膚什麼都吸收得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那就試試這款水潤型的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 它看起來就像普通的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soothing, like when skin is red?
dialogue.zh: 鎮靜，是指皮膚泛紅的時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cheeks go red in winter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should it be thick or light?
dialogue.zh: 應該用滋潤的還是清爽的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light in the day, thick at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt ɪn ðə deɪ θɪk æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 白天用清爽款，晚上用滋潤款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has a light citrus scent.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 主要是，來自真正的水果精油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is the cream for nights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這款面霜看起來很滋養。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little goes a long way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does one jar last?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 噢，我經常忘記塗防曬霜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很遺憾，大多數人都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，太陽會讓皮膚老化。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, and it wears better.
dialogue.zh: 強一點，而且防護更持久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這款塗上去很清爽透明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I also see a serum?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 精華液是針對特定問題的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a few dark spots.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛看起來很疲憊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I rub my eyes a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have anything for lips?
dialogue.zh: 你們有唇膏類的產品嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這款潤唇膏能修護乾裂嘴唇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know a lot about skin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is my job, thank you!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I walk around and look first?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ wɔk əˈraʊnd ænd lʊk fɜrst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, I will be around.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm aɪ wɪl bi əˈraʊnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shelf has everything for faces.
dialogue.zh: 這個架子全是臉部保養品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The body shelves are behind you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only need products for my face.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli nid ˈprɑdəkts fər maɪ feɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then start with these three basics.
dialogue.zh: 那就從這三樣基礎開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You already get the whole plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I test this cleanser first?
dialogue.zh: 我能先試用這款潔面乳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the testers are here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wash my hands first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold water is fine for tests.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much product do I use?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub it gently on your cheek.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 洗後皮膚應該感覺很平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的感覺很平靜，不緊繃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a small spot here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have cleansing wipes, one moment.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, may I check your list?
dialogue.zh: 現在，我能看看你的清單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 還有什麼讓你的皮膚不舒服？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我吃了杏仁之後會爆痘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does your skin react to nut oils?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz jʊr skɪn riˈækt tu nʌt ˈɔɪlz?/
dialogue.zh: 那你的皮膚對堅果油也會過敏嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think almond oil is fine.
dialogue.zh: 我想杏仁油應該沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This balm has none of it.
dialogue.zh: 這款唇膏不含那個成分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me read the tiny print.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這裡不含讓皮膚變乾的酒精。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的皮膚屏障現在感覺很弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I try the vitamin C serum?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ traɪ ðə ˈvaɪtəmən si ˈsɪrəm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put one drop on your hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more test before you buy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Behind your ear, wait ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘了……還是沒有反應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How does the cream feel now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will sit well under makeup.
dialogue.zh: 上妝前當打底也很服貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we test the sunscreen too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 笑一個，你通過了所有測試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些濕巾能清潔刷子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very wise, keep it that way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 用放大鏡能看到小細節。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有信心的顧客決定得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I store these in my bathroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ stɔr ðiz ɪn maɪ ˈbæθˌrum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool and dark places work better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So not near my hot shower?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不行，高溫會破壞活性成分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My room will be a good place.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rum wɪl bi ə ɡʊd pleɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A drawer is the perfect home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does an open jar last?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ən ˈoʊpən dʒɑr læst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This number twelve in a tin?
dialogue.zh: 這個開蓋罐上寫的十二？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the cream smells sour?
dialogue.zh: 如果面霜聞起來發酸呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toss it, even if it looks fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔs ɪt ˈivən ɪf ɪt lʊks faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 扔了吧，哪怕看起來沒事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the hydrating cream?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is more than I planned.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have a smaller jar too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the small one cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big jar is better value, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ dʒɑr ɪz ˈbɛtər ˈvæljə raɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it lasts about four months.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the serum in this range too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈsɪrəm ɪn ðɪs reɪndʒ tu?/
dialogue.zh: 精華液也在這個價位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you need only three drops.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three drops for my whole face?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these bottles ever go on sale?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz ˈbɑtəlz ˈɛvɚ ɡoʊ əˈn seɪl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one says buy one, get one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn sɛz baɪ wʌn ɡɛt wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that is our best deal!
dialogue.zh: 噢，那是我們最划算的活動！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cleansers for the price of one?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈklɛnzərz fər ðə praɪs ʌv wʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could use a spare one.
dialogue.zh: 我正好可以用一個備用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 凝膠款也參加這個活動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the eye cream count too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a set that may help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə sɛt ðæt meɪ hɛlp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A set? What is inside it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 潔面、精華、面霜，一盒齊全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the set cheaper than single items?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə sɛt ˈtʃipər ðæn ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈaɪtəmz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it saves about twenty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me see the box, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, this blue one on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 包裝真好看。能直接送人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, no wrapping needed at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom's birthday is next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This set makes a lovely gift.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a version for men?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I will take one of each.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi aɪ wɪl teɪk wʌn ʌv itʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great idea, they last for months.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, do you have student discounts?
dialogue.zh: 等等，你們有學生折扣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten percent with a school card.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɛn pərˈsɛnt wɪð ə skul kɑrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is she here with you today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not today, she is on campus.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she must come with the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi məst kʌm wɪð ðə kɑrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our app gives points on everything.
dialogue.zh: 我們的 App 消費都有積分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many points get free cream?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five hundred, about a year of shopping.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈhʌndrəd əˈbaʊt ə jɪr ʌv ˈʃɑpɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 五百分，大約一年的消費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I shop here twice a year.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm aɪ ʃɑp hɪr twaɪs ə jɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then try our member sale days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is the next member sale?
dialogue.zh: 下次會員折扣日是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wait and buy then?
dialogue.zh: 那我要等到那天再買嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If your skin can wait, yes.
dialogue.zh: 如果你的皮膚等得起，就等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My face cannot wait that long.
dialogue.zh: 我的臉可等不了那麼久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want me to compare two brands?
dialogue.zh: 要我幫你對比兩個牌子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is cheaper, this is richer.
dialogue.zh: 這個便宜些，這個更滋潤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the rich one worth the extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə rɪtʃ wʌn wɜrθ ði ˈɛkstrə?/
dialogue.zh: 貴的那款值那個差價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the light one for summer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, thin lotions suit humid heat.
dialogue.zh: 對，稀乳液適合潮濕的夏天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you price match the store downtown?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju praɪs mætʃ ðə stɔr ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 你們跟市區的店比價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They had the serum cheaper there.
dialogue.zh: 他們那裡的精華更便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the ad and we will check.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə æd ænd wi wɪl tʃɛk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved their flyer in my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪvd ðɛr ˈflaɪər ɪn maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 他們的促銷單我存在手機裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about refill pouches for later?
dialogue.zh: 那之後可以買補充袋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, refill pouches cost fifteen less.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pouch? How does that work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pour it into your empty bottle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 買補充裝的會員還有額外積分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the cheapest thing here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our plain petroleum jelly, four dollars.
dialogue.zh: 我們的普通凡士林，4 美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can cheap really fix dry skin?
dialogue.zh: 便宜的真能改善幹皮膚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It seals moisture like nothing else.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for hands in winter, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I thought everyone needed fancy cream.
dialogue.zh: 我以為人人都得用高級面霜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart routines mix simple and active.
dialogue.zh: 聰明的保養是簡單加有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I do not need everything?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You need four honest steps only.
dialogue.zh: 你需要的只是踏實做好四步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You just recited the whole routine!
dialogue.zh: 你剛把整套步驟背出來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those four steps are hard to forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz fɔr stɛps ɑr hɑrd tu fərˈɡɛt./
dialogue.zh: 這四個步驟我肯定忘不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it while you shop with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt waɪl ju ʃɑp wɪð ʌs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will stick to just this basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl stɪk tu dʒʌst ðɪs ˈbæskət./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you find everything you need?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three creams and one serum here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡三罐面霜和一瓶精華。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will scan them one by one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl skæn ðɛm wʌn baɪ wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my phone number?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you want member points.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your name for the account?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just my first name works fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, you are all set.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That comes to one hundred six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hundred six? On this slip?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the flyer photo, remember?
dialogue.zh: 這是促銷單照片，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh yes, the serum price match.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Would you like a gift receipt?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A gift receipt? What is that?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then yes, the set is a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɛs ðə sɛt ɪz ə ɡɪft./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will add the special slip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom will love that box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue one? A classic choice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, please. Should I tap it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap right on this small reader.
dialogue.zh: 貼著這個小感應器就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks for my zip code.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it in, then press enter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get my receipt emailed?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is name at work dot com.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz neɪm æt wɜrk dɑt kɑm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need a paper bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a bag with handles.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And keep the jars closed tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four small packets, right on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The night cream is the best one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə naɪt krim ɪz ðə bɛst wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which packet holds the night cream?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The silver one, near your hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does your return policy work?
dialogue.zh: 你們的退貨規定是怎樣的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even if I opened a jar?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if a cream breaks me out?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪv ə krim breɪks mi aʊt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it back, we will help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my sister return her set?
dialogue.zh: 我姐姐能退她的套裝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with the receipt and card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is quite a picky shopper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep the gift box?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about orders from your website?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mail returns are just as easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is this a free sticker?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will place it on my mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pleɪs ɪt ɑn maɪ ˈmɪrər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, three quick tips for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Serum at night, sunscreen in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪrəm æt naɪt ˈsʌnˌskrɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 精華晚上用，防曬早上用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the serum only at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works best while you sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change one product at a time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I know what caused trouble.
dialogue.zh: 這樣才知道是什麼惹的禍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will I see real results?
dialogue.zh: 什麼時候才能看到效果？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four weeks, I can do that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your skin feels better in days.
dialogue.zh: 幾天之後皮膚就會有感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I drink more water too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will sleep help my tired eyes?
dialogue.zh: 睡覺能幫到我疲憊的眼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So late nights are the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This was my best shopping trip.
dialogue.zh: 這是我最滿意的一次購物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You asked all the right questions.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for all your help tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 睡個好覺，明天光彩照人！
